title: AndHeGames 32×32 creature concept sheets
creator: AndHeGames
attribution: Not required. Optional credit: ‘Creature concepts’ by AndHeGames via OpenGameArt, CC0 1.0.
suitability: Reference library only until an owner-approved adaptation passes Mossvale's actual-scale art review. These compact four-color sprites have a visibly different pixel density and rendering style from current Mossvale production art.
limits: These files are images only. They do not provide creature names, lore, element, stats, behavior, animation, balance or runtime IDs.
The OpenGameArt pages do not state whether AI tools were used; this registry makes no inference about that.
CC0 addresses copyright and related rights as described by its legal code; it does not grant unrelated trademark, patent, privacy or publicity rights and is provided without warranty.
Do not present these reference sheets as reviewed Mossvale game art or include them in a shipped adventure without a separate design and visual review.
